# Settings

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/logic/settings/`](../folders/src-logic-settings.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/settings/settings.h`](../../../src/logic/settings/settings.h), [`src/logic/settings/settings.cpp`](../../../src/logic/settings/settings.cpp)

## Summary

User settings loaded from ./config.6.json and overridden by key=value arguments.

## Description

Host context variable emplaced in the Game constructor (dynamical only) as Settings(argc, argv): load() reads DYNAMICAL_CONFIG_FILE (DYNAMICAL_CONFIG_DIR "config.6.json", default ./config.6.json) with cereal JSON if it exists and always rewrites it, then argument_override applies key=value arguments (window_width, window_height, fullscreen, fps_max, username, server_side, client_side, vr_mode, view_distance; spectator_mode cannot be overridden; booleans are true only for the string "true"). Game forces vr_mode = 0 when the scene's renderer has vr false. Read by Windu, VRContext, DebugMenu, ChunkManagerSys (view_distance, with Settings::default_view_distance = 768 when absent).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `window_width` | `int` | 0 | 0: picked by Windu |
| `window_height` | `int` | 0 | 0: picked by Windu |
| `fullscreen` | `bool` | true |  |
| `fps_max` | `int` | 60 |  |
| `username` | `std::string` | "John Doe" | legacy |
| `server_side` | `bool` | false | legacy |
| `client_side` | `bool` | false | legacy |
| `vr_mode` | `int` | 1 | 0 desktop only, 1 VR alongside the desktop when a headset is available |
| `spectator_mode` | `int` | 2 | serialized only |
| `view_distance` | `int` | 768 (default_view_distance) | chunks load within this distance of the cameras, world units |
